IGUI_TienInspectWeapon_NoWeapon: Nothing in your hands to inspect.
IGUI_TienInspectWeapon_AnchorPoint_toolt: The point of the window that stays put. When the window grows or shrinks to fit a weapon, this point holds still and the rest of the window moves around it, and when the window opens again this point goes back where you left it.
IGUI_TienInspectWeapon_ResetPosition_too: Moves the window back to its starting spot above the hotbar and forgets where it was left, at every screen resolution. The anchor point is kept.
